title: Random Duo #18 (임산부+바디페인팅)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different Living Artifact track.

#1 (Pregnant): Chinese, in her early 50s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head, real pores, real living eyes, 200 studs piercings set with diamonds in mixed-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of rose-gold a ring. Painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer, deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle, wide gold-leaf bands curving fully around her belly, the densest concentration of eggshell-white scrollwork wrapping the belly as centrepiece and continuing over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, extreme gold-leaf platform stiletto peep-toe heels.

#2 (Bodypaint): a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, bold and confident, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted. Pose: back fully to camera. Footwear: extreme gold plain stiletto pumps.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 2, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio.
